shortDescription: Import Podman container from a tar file.

options.name: change
options.description: Set changes as list of key-value pairs, see example.

options.name: commit_message
options.description: Set commit message for imported image

options.name: executable
options.description: Path to C(podman) executable if it is not in the C($PATH) on the machine running C(podman)

options.name: src
options.description: Path to image file to load.

options.name: volume
options.description: Volume to import, cannot be used with change and commit_message
